limitations: Exactly three independent area-uniform sites on the unit two-sphere; labelled cell areas; no assertion for other site counts, nonuniform laws, or area-weighted cell selection. Missing full-text historical sources remain a novelty risk.
scientific_integrity: One joint law and one derived largest-cell statistic are proved by a classical geometric disintegration and explicit integration. The general disintegration, one-cell distribution, and acute-triangle event are attributed to prior work. No independent validation or definitive historical-priority claim.
title: Joint area and largest-cell laws for three random spherical Voronoi lunes
